title: C7 (Result/Option built-in with payload-in-contract): parse_u64 (String->u64, #94 C4) needs a built-in Option<u64>/Result<u64,ParseErr> return + 'result is Some'/payload-projection in a contract (ens result is Some ==> parse_be(s) == <payload>). The Thermite surface has user enums + Expr::Is + match, but NO enum-payload projection in the spec sublanguage (no result->Some_0; Expr::Field is struct-only). GROUNDED in verus: parse_u64 -> Option<u64> verifies 5/0 (parse_be round-trip ens, loud None on non-digit/overflow/empty), broken Some(0) FAILS 1 err. push_byte/from_byte + u64_to_string (round-trip parse_le==n, 9/0) ship now under #94; parse_u64 DEPENDS-ON this C7 prereq.
